products.name: PM Surya Ghar — Residential Rooftop CFA
products.eligible_for: Residential households installing grid-connected rooftop solar
products.rate_note: Not applicable — capital subsidy, not a loan
products.tenure_note: One-time disbursal after installation and inspection
products.amount_note: ₹30,000/kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000/kW for the third kW, capped at ₹78,000

products.name: IREDA Renewable Energy Term Loan
